info.name: HW06 FR-08 Checkout — POST /api/checkout
info.description:
MANUAL-IMPORT COPY for Postman Desktop. Identical in behaviour to the canonical implementation work/postman/fr08/FR08-checkout.postman_collection.json (sha256 7d185f739fa800f84d4433ddd7586928aabae225277e88b546984926e099de82); only info.name and info._postman_id differ, so no request, script, oracle or data value was changed.

Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.
